hero.eyebrow: RIDES AND DELIVERY, ALL IN ONE APP
hero.description: Request a reliable ride to your destination or send a package safely and quickly. Rover keeps every journey simple, convenient and easy to track.
hero.appStoreAriaLabel: Download Rover on the App Store
hero.phoneImageAlt: Rover mobile application showing the driver selection screen

about.introduction: Rover connects you with nearby drivers whenever you need a ride or want to send a package. From request to arrival, every step is designed to be simple, visible and reliable.
about.journeyTitle: Move through your day with confidence.
about.requestRideDescription: Find a nearby driver and travel comfortably to your chosen destination.
about.sendPackageDescription: Arrange fast and reliable delivery for documents, parcels and everyday items.
about.trackEveryStepDescription: Follow your driver, ride or delivery progress directly from the application.
about.safetyDescription: Clear trip information and dependable service help you move with confidence.
about.flexibleDescription: Use Rover for personal travel, important deliveries or anything in between.

features.introduction: Whether you are travelling across town or sending something important, Rover gives you the tools to request, manage and track everything from one place.

services.label: TWO SERVICES
services.title: Ride or delivery, whenever you need it.
services.description: Switch between requesting transport for yourself and sending a package without leaving the application.

tracking.label: LIVE PROGRESS
tracking.title: Know where your driver is.
tracking.description: See the route, estimated arrival time and current journey status in real time.

clearPricing.title: Clear pricing
clearPricing.description: View an estimated fare before confirming your request, with clear payment information.

fastMatching.title: Fast driver matching
fastMatching.description: Rover quickly searches for a suitable nearby driver for your ride or delivery.

safety.title: Safety built in
safety.description: Trip details, driver information and live progress help you move with confidence.

flexibleDeliveries.title: Flexible deliveries
flexibleDeliveries.description: Send documents, parcels and everyday items without arranging separate transport.

howItWorks.introduction: Rover keeps the entire process clear. Choose what you need, confirm the details and follow the journey from beginning to end.

locations.title: Set your locations
locations.description: Enter the pickup point and destination for your ride or package.

service.title: Choose your service
service.description: Select a passenger ride or package delivery and review the details.

matching.title: Get matched
matching.description: Rover finds a nearby driver and shows their information before arrival.

tracking.title: Track every step
tracking.description: Follow the journey live until you or your package reaches the destination.

preview.roverOnWay: Your Rover is on the way

security.introduction: Rover is designed to help you feel informed and supported throughout every ride and delivery. Clear journey details keep you aware of what is happening, while the Rover support team remains ready to assist if something does not go as expected.

assurance.label: BUILT AROUND YOUR CONFIDENCE
assurance.title: Help is always close when you need it.
assurance.description: Open the in-app support page, explain what happened and connect with a team prepared to guide you through the next step.

visibleJourneys.title: Visible journeys
visibleJourneys.description: View driver, route and trip information so you always know what is happening.

protectedInformation.title: Protected information
protectedInformation.description: Rover is designed to keep your account and journey details handled securely.

supportWithinReach.title: Support within reach
supportWithinReach.description: Contact the Rover support team directly whenever you need guidance or assistance.

supportBanner.label: ROVER CUSTOMER SUPPORT
supportBanner.description: A real team, ready when something happens.

signup.introduction: Join the Rover updates list for important announcements, new features, service-area launches and useful ride and delivery news.

serviceAreas.title: New service areas
serviceAreas.description: Be the first to know when Rover reaches a new location.

productUpdates.title: Product updates
productUpdates.description: Discover new ride and delivery features as they launch.

safetyNews.title: Safety news
safetyNews.description: Receive useful information about security and support.

form.title: Get the latest from Rover.
form.description: Useful updates only. No unnecessary messages and no clutter.
form.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
form.successMessage: You are now on the Rover updates list.
form.privacy: Your email will only be used for Rover news and updates.

footer.description: Rover makes transportation easier by helping users request rides, send packages and track their journeys from one convenient platform.
